name: mesa-cliff-overhang
description: Rebuilt after direct feedback: compact irregular terraced stone alcove, no diagonal cliff grid. Low 0.6m terrace, roof about2.9m above floor, named shelter_zone preserved.
brief: Use ONLY phase-2/mesa-cliff-overhang.png. User rejected the 30m by15m striped cliff; supersede catalog scale with a compact roughly12m wide by5.5m tall rock alcove. Broad chipped strata, actual recessed opening, low accessible terrace, sample pedestal, shelter_zone for astronaut and PEBBLE. No other visual references.
